member.name: T:Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture
member.summary: Provides functionality to capture screenshots of the desktop, active windows, or specific windows.

remarks.para: This class uses Windows API (user32.dll) to capture screen content. It provides methods to capture the entire desktop, the currently active window, or any specific window by handle. Optionally, it can draw a crosshair indicator at the current cursor position.

item.description: Desktop capture: Capture the entire desktop screen
Active window capture: Capture only the currently active/foreground window
Specific window capture: Capture any window by its handle
Cursor visualization: Optionally draw a crosshair at the cursor position

remarks.para: Platform support: This class requires Windows and is designed for .NET Framework 4.7.2 and .NET 8+. It uses P/Invoke to call native Windows APIs.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.GetForegroundWindow
member.summary: Retrieves a handle to the foreground window (the window with which the user is currently working).
member.returns: A handle to the foreground window. The foreground window can be in certain circumstances, such as when a window is losing activation.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.GetDesktopWindow
member.summary: Retrieves a handle to the desktop window.
member.returns: A handle to the desktop window.
member.remarks: The desktop window covers the entire screen. The desktop window is the area on top of which other windows are painted.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.GetWindowRect(System.IntPtr,Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.Rect@)
member.summary: Retrieves the dimensions of the bounding rectangle of the specified window.
member.param: A reference to a structure that receives the screen coordinates of the upper-left and lower-right corners of the window.
member.returns: A handle to the window rectangle. The actual rectangle coordinates are returned in the parameter.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.GetCursorPos(Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.POINT@)
member.summary: Retrieves the position of the mouse cursor in screen coordinates.
member.param: An output parameter that receives a structure containing the screen coordinates of the cursor.
member.returns: true if the function succeeds; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.CaptureDesktop(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Captures a screenshot of the entire desktop.
member.param: If true, draws a red crosshair indicator at the current cursor position on the captured image. Default is false.
member.returns: An containing the desktop screenshot, or null if the desktop window handle is invalid.

remarks.para: This method captures all visible content on all monitors in a multi-monitor setup. The resulting image dimensions correspond to the virtual screen bounds.
Cursor visualization: When is true, a crosshair is drawn with:

item.description: A red filled circle (12px diameter) as the outer marker
White horizontal and vertical lines forming a cross
A smaller white filled circle (4px diameter) at the center

member.name: M:Fuxion.Drawing.ScreenCapture.CaptureActiveWindow(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Captures a screenshot of the currently active (foreground) window.
member.param: If true, draws a red crosshair indicator at the current cursor position on the captured image. Default is false.
member.returns: A containing the active window screenshot, or null if there is no active window or the window handle is invalid.

remarks.para: The active window is the window that currently has keyboard focus. This method captures only the client and non-client areas of that specific window, excluding any overlapping windows.
If the cursor is outside the active window bounds and is true, the crosshair will not be visible in the resulting image.
